title: Webhook delivery · uncertain cause and provider failure
originalNotes: 13:02 Partner webhook deliveries returned HTTP 503 for two synthetic test events.
13:06 Operator retried one synthetic event; it returned HTTP 202.
13:09 Partner dashboard still showed the other event as undelivered.
13:11 Provider status page showed degraded delivery; status may be unrelated.
13:14 API request to inspect delivery details timed out. No further retry was performed.
No confirmation that the 202 event was processed downstream.
Next shift: reconcile event IDs against provider receipts before retrying; avoid duplicate delivery.

expectedHandoff.observedImpact: Two synthetic webhook deliveries returned HTTP 503 at 13:02; at 13:09 the partner dashboard still showed one event as undelivered.
expectedHandoff.actionsAndResults: One synthetic event was retried at 13:06 and returned HTTP 202, which does not confirm downstream processing. A delivery-details API request timed out at 13:14; no further retry occurred.
expectedHandoff.openQuestions: The provider reported degraded delivery at 13:11 but its relationship to this incident is unconfirmed. The downstream status of the HTTP 202 event is unknown.
expectedHandoff.nextStep: Reconcile event IDs against provider receipts before retrying to avoid duplicates.
